ctx: 영화 「The Family Plan 2」(2025, Apple TV+ action comedy, sequel to The Family Plan 2023). Mark Wahlberg as Dan Morgan (real name Sean McCaffrey), a former assassin who now runs a private security firm; Michelle Monaghan as his wife Jessica Morgan (offered a coaching job in Ohio); Zoe Colletti as daughter Nina Morgan, studying in London; Van Crosby as son Kyle Morgan, a gamer and hacker; toddler son Max; Kit Harington as Finn Clarke, Dan's secret half-brother and the villain; Sidse Babett Knudsen as Svetlana Romanova, Dan's former Russian intelligence contact in Paris; Sanjeev Bhaskar as Vikram, the butler of the Paris mansion; Reda Elazouar as Omar, Nina's boyfriend (his father is the Interpol Secretary General). Story: their father, crime syndicate leader McCaffrey, dies in prison. At Christmas the family visits Nina in London; Finn hires Dan for a bank security test and forces him into a heist for a digital key; the Morgans flee as fugitives chased by Finn's men; the key unlocks the late father's servers (money, hired assassins, surveillance network) based in his Paris childhood mansion; Dan and Finn meet at a museum; Finn puts a bounty on Dan; Svetlana drugs Dan, then warns them; car chase; Dan and Omar cross the rooftops into the mansion while Nina's friends stage a protest and Jessica and Kyle upload a virus that wipes the servers; Dan fights Finn; French police arrest them, Omar's father clears them; epilogue in Columbus, Ohio, Dan visits Finn in prison.
